skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental views of Marxism-Leninism on the working class and its historical mission, the content, manifestations, and significance of this mission in the current context.
Grasp the basic views of Marxism-Leninism on socialism, the transitional period to socialism, and the creative application of the Party's policies in Vietnam.

Recognize the essential characteristics of socialist democracy and the socialist state, and understand the social structure, class alliances, and ethnic and religious issues in the transitional period to socialism.
Understand the views of Marxism-Leninism, Ho Chi Minh's thoughts, and the Vietnamese Communist Party on family issues in the transitional period to socialism.
Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze the historical mission of the working class in Vietnam's revolutionary process.
Analyze fundamental issues about socialism and the path to socialism in Vietnam.
Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze practical issues related to socialist democracy, the socialist state, class alliances, ethnic and religious issues.
Work independently and in groups to solve problems.
Develop the ability to learn independently and seek out materials to complete assignments.
Build confidence in the socialist system and support the policies of the Vietnamese Communist Party.
Maintain a positive attitude towards studying political theory courses and take responsibility for assigned activities.
